  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery on agreed project milestones
  • Ensure an ongoing commitment to strict quality and reliability standards
  • Engage with other teams at Canonical to ensure alignment on product architecture and roadmaps
  • Work from home with global travel up to twice a year for up to two weeks

Who you are

  • You have worked with Linux distributions, debian packaging and high performance, server-class hardware
  • You have experience working directly with customers, resolving their technical issues, interpreting their business challenges and effectively communicating how your solution will meet their needs
  • You have demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers
  • You have understanding of agile software development methodologies
  • You collaborate effectively across multiple internal teams, building trust and delivering results
  • You have effective communications skills in English, both written and oral
  • You have a bachelor's (or equivalent university level) degree, preferably in a technology field

What Canonical offers

  • Learning and Development opportunities
  • Annual Compensation Review
  • Recognition Rewards
  • Annual Leave

title: Quality Engineer, Product QA
description:
The Quality Engineer, Product QA (Welding discipline)will be responsible for:

  • Support product engineering on welding requirements identification, review and implementation.

  • To develop project welding matrix aligned with Material's Engineering Team.

  • To qualify product welding processes in-house and review supplier's qualification processes.

  • Record properly the welding qualifications on PQRs and WPS.

  • Review and approve local work instructions for welding.

  • Implement and control welding consumables best practices and requirements, including the required approvals per relevant industry codes.

  • Oversight welding operations in-house and in suppliers as per ABNT NBR 14842 duties.

  • Witness laboratory tests for welding and welder qualifications and report out.

  • To control welder qualification record and its performance according to relevant standards.

  • Deploy continuous improvement actions on welding operations based on product performance.

  • Support Project Quality team for welding discipline across the live projects.

  • Interface with customer SME in welding during project execution.

  • Ensure critical observations e concerns are properly identified and escalated to the respective levels of the organization.

  • Run product quality audits and walks in a frequent basis to certify project requirements are flowed down.

  • Support lead Go No Go process for fabrication start and facilitate pre-production meeting.

  • Ensure welding Lessons Learned are properly captured, solved and communicated to product delivery and supply team.

  • Ensure product non-conformances are properly identified, recorded by the relevant point of contact responsible for fabrication.

  • Witness product inspections and processes/product qualification inspections as per the relevant inspection and test plan, and report-out.

  • Review and approve the supplier quality welding records.

  • Handle communication with direct colleagues and the business about approach and methods for solving complex problems

  • Adhere to Product Line directive for standard quality requirements in fabrication sites.

  • Contribute in the root cause analises of welding non-conformances/problems

  • Support the Quality in team in NDE inspections applicability / improvements in-house or in suppliers

  • Review and approve weld maps.

Required Characteristics

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college in (Mechanical, Welding, Materials or Production discipline).

  • Fluent in English.

  • Knowledge in local Brazilian customer quality requirements related to fabrication of subsea equipment including XT, Manifolds and Tooling.

  • Strong and proven experience on welding discipline for subsea equipment.

  • Experience in Quality audits to support customer project assessments.

  • Knowledge in product quality inspection and documentation analysis.

  • Experience with customer interface.

  • Knowledge of NDE inspections (MP, DP, UT, PAUT, etc)

  • Knowledge of usual materials used in the Oil&Gas industry

  • Welding Inspector Qualification (FBTS Level 2)

  • Knowledge of usual materials used in the Oil&Gas industry

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.

  • Ability to influence others and lead small teams. Lead initiatives of moderate scope and impact.

  • Ability to coordinate several projects simultaneously. Effective problem identification and solution skills. Proven analytical and organizational ability.

Location:Curitiba, PR.

Segunda á Sexta das 09h as 16h.

Somos a TD SYNNEX (NYSE: SNX), um distribuidor líder e agregador de soluções para o ecossistema de TI.

Somos dos melhores e mais brilhantes do setor de TI, que compartilham uma paixão inabalável por trazer produtos, serviços e soluções de tecnologia atraentes para o mundo. Somos um parceiro inovador que ajuda nossos clientes a maximizar o valor dos investimentos em TI, demonstrar resultados de negócios e desbloquear oportunidades de crescimento.

Em nossa essência, somos uma empresa que se preocupa . Nós nos preocupamos com nossos parceiros, nossos colegas de trabalho, nossos investidores e o mundo ao nosso redor. E estamos comprometidos em ser um empregador de escolha diversificado e inclusivo e um bom cidadão corporativo.

Nossos valores

Inclusão

Sua voz importa.

Com diversas origens, conhecimentos e experiências, nossos colaboradores nos tornam quem somos. Quando buscamos nos entender e reconhecer o poder do indivíduo, demonstramos respeito e dignidade; aprendemos, evoluímos e desbloqueamos o potencial para alcançar resultados excelentes para nossos clientes e vencermos juntos.

Essa ampla perspectiva é parte integrante do nosso compromisso com a diversidade, equidade e inclusão.

Colaboração

Ampliamos os pontos fortes.

Atendemos às demandas em constante evolução de nossos clientes e do mercado, trazendo o melhor de nosso pessoal e de nossos parceiros em todos os aspectos da cadeia de suprimentos.

Quando aproveitamos nossa experiência coletiva, ouvimos bem, apoiamos e inspiramos uns aos outros, fazemos mais do que atingir nossos objetivos – fazemos grandes coisas.

Integridade

Caráter importa.

Agir com honestidade, transparência, respeito e justiça gera confiança. A confiança fomenta o espírito empreendedor e é um catalisador para a inovação que gera excelentes resultados para nossos clientes.

Quando nos responsabilizamos pelos mais altos padrões, criamos um ambiente aberto e honesto que promove ideias criativas e agrega valor aos nossos clientes, fornecedores e uns aos outros.

Excelência

Vencemos juntos.

Entregamos valor aos nossos clientes e fornecedores por meio de nossa forte ética de trabalho e nosso compromisso com a excelência. Buscamos proativamente oportunidades e enfrentamos desafios. Nós nos adaptamos rapidamente e executamos com confiança para maximizar os resultados para nossos parceiros e nossos negócios.

Quando adotamos uma mentalidade orientada, os pontos fortes da propriedade individual e da colaboração se unem naturalmente, o aprendizado se incorpora ao processo e oferecemos experiências significativas em todos os lugares

Aqui, o Direito é dinâmico, tecnológico e humano.

title: Agriculture Reporter
description:
Agriculture Reporter - Brazil (Rio)

Location

Rio de Janeiro

Business Area

News and Media

Ref #

Description & Requirements


We are seeking an experienced reporter to drive our agriculture coverage in Brazil — one of the world's most dynamic and influential economies for commodities. You'll take on a crucial beat focused on soft commodities such as coffee, cocoa, and sugar, with a strong emphasis on ethanol. Your reporting will span market movements, global trading trends, government policy, corporate strategy, farmer sentiment, and consumer and environmental issues. The ideal candidate will have a deep curiosity about how Brazil's agricultural sector operates — from farms to boardrooms — and a keen sense of how developments there ripple across global markets and economies.

Brazil has rapidly become an agricultural powerhouse, reshaping global trade and intensifying debates around s

ustainability.

You'll be responsible for delivering agenda-setting journalism that captures this transformation — from scoops and breaking news to deeply reported enterprise pieces.

Working alongside colleagues in Brazil and across Bloomberg's global network, you'll stay on top of news affecting commodities futures, corporate moves and M&A, regulation and policy — and help bring clarity and insight to our global audience. Along with soft commodities, you'll be responsible for pulp and paper.

This position can be done from Rio or Sao Paulo. To be considered, please submit your application by Friday, December 5.

Resumes must be submitted in English to be considered

We'll trust you to:

  • Monitor and explain market moves on major commodities, writing with precision and insight for sophisticated readers
  • Be a self-starter, and someone who can thrive in a fast-paced news environment
  • Generate original story and project ideas that vividly illustrate how Brazil's commodities markets influence traders, farmers, corporations, and consumers.
  • Interpret and analyze the affects of tariffs on markets and trade
  • Break news on issues including policymaking and environmental developments
  • Collaborate closely with colleagues across teams, bureaus and continents to deliver a global perspective to our readers

You'll need to have:

  • At least 5 years of experience in business or financial journalism
  • Experience in a real-time news environment
  • A proven track record reporting and writing about business in Brazil
  • Demonstrated success in building your own sources to break news
  • An ability to write quickly and clearly under deadline pressure
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Demonstrated continuous career growth and initiative within an organization
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

We'd love to see:

  • Familiarity with journalism across platforms, including digital, video, podcasts and data visualization
  • Preferably experience covering agriculture or other commodities

Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

title: Field Agent
description:
Result of Service

The Field Agent reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Expected duration

Three (3) months, with possibility of renewal

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. The Social Territories Programme has been implemented since 2019, first in large favela complexes (Alemão, Chapadão, Cidade de Deus, Lins, Maré, Pedreira, Penha, Jacarezinho, Rocinha and Vila Kennedy), and currently in larger scale throughout the city. To properly continue the Social Territories Programme's implementation, a Field Agent is required to support field research activities in designated areas of the city. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Field Agent reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Field Agent will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Apply questionnaires to selected families in designated areas as determined in the Programme's workplan. b) Work collaboratively with other Field Agents and his/her Local Manager to meet individual and collective quota for their designated areas. c) Visit and assist selected families at the request of the Programme Coordination. d) Provide logistical and operational support in local events. e) Participate in local meetings. f) Attend training and information sessions. g) Disseminate information about the Programme in designated areas. h) Elaborate and deliver a Monthly Activity Report in a timely manner. i) Be responsible, within its competencies, to ensure that technical activities are aligned with quality expectations of the Agency and its counterparts. j) Perform other duties which may be requested by the Programme's team. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Field Agent will carry out field research and support the Programme's active search, integrated service and monitoring activities. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities' report.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• High School Diploma is required, or additional two (2) years or relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience:
• Minimum one (1) year of experience in research, data collection and/or conducting interviews/questionnaires, preferably in the intervened/vulnerable communities, is required.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good handling of technological tools is required.
• Knowledge and experience with data collection applications, such as Survey123, is desirable.
• Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office and Microsoft Excel, is desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.

Additional Information

Travel details: Not Applicable. Remuneration SB-2/1 – BRL: 2.389,08 (net amount) UNDP Brazil Salary Scale Notes Appointment against this post is on local basis and only nationals from Brazil or external candidates who hold a permanent visa in Brazil may apply. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted in the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Due to the volume of applications received, receipt of applications cannot be acknowledged individually. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. Applications should be submitted through INSPIRA and must include all documents required at the system, please be ready to include the following information at the "Candidate Profile" (CP) at Inspira:
• Cover memo (maximum 1 page)
• Educational Background (incl. dates)
• Professional Experience (assignments, tasks, achievements, duration by years/ months)
• Expertise and preferences regarding location of potential assignments
• Other Experience and Expertise (e.g. Internships/ voluntary work, etc.)* * Please note that Internships, self-employment and part-time count as 50%. In addition to it, note experience not relevant to the position will not be considered. All applications should be submitted to: Inspira UN-HABITAT does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruitment process. If you have any questions concerning people or companies claiming to be recruiting on behalf of these offices and requesting the payment of a fee, please contact:

No Fee

THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CHARGE A FEE AT ANY STAGE OF THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS (APPLICATION, INTERVIEW MEETING, PROCESSING, OR TRAINING). THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CONCERN ITSELF WITH INFORMATION ON APPLICANTS' BANK ACCOUNTS.

Por que trabalhar conosco?
Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão em prática fazendo a diferença nos 178 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 26 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.

A Concessionária
A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

A partir de 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

title: Gerente Sênior de Crescimento
description:
Descrição e Responsabilidades:
Horário: 9h às 18h
Nível: Managerial and Executive
Regime de contratação: Fixed Term

1. COMO É SER GERENTE (SÊNIOR) DE CRESCIMENTO EM MSF-BRASIL:

Você irá desenvolver e liderar a estratégia do funil de crescimento e de melhoria contínua do retorno sobre investimento das ações de captação de recursos de MSF-Brasil, maximizando a contribuição para os projetos médico-humanitários da organização pelo mundo. Irá trabalhar para encantar, conquistar e fidelizar pessoas doadoras por meio de engajamento contínuo, diversificando canais e garantindo a sustentabilidade do programa de captação de recursos de MSF-Brasil a longo prazo.

Além disso, deverá desenvolver e incentivar estratégias ousadas, inovadoras, orientadas por dados e que reforcem a marca de MSF, fomentando uma relação com pessoas doadoras pautadas pela ética e transparência, visando sempre a segurança e privacidade de dados. Atuando em estreita colaboração com outras lideranças, garantindo uma abordagem alinhada com a estratégia de MSF-Brasil como um todo e assegurando que o crescimento seja conduzido de forma ética, inclusiva e responsável, considerando a diversidade de públicos, contextos e impactos das estratégias adotadas.

2. QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS?

  • Ampliar a base de pessoas doadoras ativas de MSF-Brasil, buscando caminhos inovadores para enfrentar os diferentes desafios no mercado e considerando cada etapa do funil de crescimento;
  • Aumentar a receita de MSF-Brasil, garantindo eficiência nas atividades de crescimento e buscando maximizar Retorno sobre Investimento (ROI);
    Promover cultura de captação de recursos na organização, equilibrando crescimento, inovação e performance com decisões éticas, inclusivas e alinhadas aos valores institucionais.

3. COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO?

Atividades de Crescimento e Estratégia

  • Zelar pela qualidade das entregas da célula, junto aos responsáveis das áreas, garantindo o atendimento às demandas com qualidade;
  • Assegurar que os processos de compras, pagamentos e reports são cumpridos pela célula de acordo com os prazos definidos;
  • Garantir gestão e monitoramento completo do funil de crescimento, desde a consciência e aquisição de pessoas doadoras até a fidelização e indicação, e identificação de oportunidades para otimizar o desempenho em cada etapa do funil por meio do monitoramento constante de métricas;
  • Garantir experimentação e implementação de novos canais e abordagens para expandir alcance e performance junto às lideranças da célula e em colaboração estreita com o time de Business Intelligence (BI);
  • Garantir otimização constante da experiência de pessoas usuárias, Régua de Relacionamento e atendimento a pessoas doadoras, zelando pela qualidade de cada contato e considerando abordagem inovadora e omnichannel;
  • Assegurar que experiências, réguas e abordagens considerem diferentes perfis, capacidades de acesso, contextos culturais e expectativas, evitando práticas excludentes e fortalecendo relações sustentáveis com pessoas doadoras;
  • Trabalhar com líderes na célula para melhorar processos e fluxos junto às outras células no hub de Engajamento Estratégico em busca de melhor eficiência e agilidade nas atividades;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com o time de Filantropia no planejamento e implementação de estratégias para desenvolver pessoas doadoras, tanto pessoas físicas quanto jurídicas, visando aumentar suas contribuições e direcioná-los à categoria de grandes doações, com atendimento personalizado pela equipe de Filantropia;
  • Garantir potencial de otimização da área de sistemas junto a Gerência de Sistemas e GTT através de investimentos em novas tecnologias;
  • Garantir que a célula de crescimento contribui e segue processos de certificação de PCI compliance de MSF e segurança de dados conforme LGPD e políticas de MSF;
  • Negociar as melhores condições de parceria de fornecedores de MSF-Brasil junto as lideranças na célula;
  • Contribuir para projetos de alto nível do Hub de Engajamento Estratégico, conforme necessário;
  • Desenvolver e liderar a estratégia do funil de crescimento de MSF-Brasil, envolvendo as áreas interessadas e garantindo participação ativa de suas equipes na construção;
  • Definir, sustentar e responsabilizar-se pela incorporação de princípios de diversidade, equidade e inclusão nas estratégias, decisões, prioridades e práticas da célula de crescimento, influenciando lideranças, equipes e parceiros e promovendo um ambiente seguro, ético e coerente com os valores de MSF;
  • Garantir participação e acompanhamento de plataformas internacionais relevantes para MSF-Brasil, trazendo ideias inovadoras e adaptando para o cenário brasileiro;

Promoção de cultura de Captação de Recursos

  • Ser responsável pela construção de uma cultura de captação de recursos em MSF-Brasil, garantindo a consistência dos programas oferecidos para as pessoas funcionarias, conscientizando a organização sobre a importância de captação de recursos e relacionamento com as pessoas doadoras;
  • Compartilhar insights e performance da área com outros departamentos da organização continuamente, assegurando trabalho transversal;
  • Participar e contribuir com o fórum de ONGs no Brasile plataformas internacionais, trazendo insumos relevantes do mercado e ideias inovadoras, adaptando para o cenário de MSF-Brasil;
    Influenciar a cultura organizacional para que práticas de captação e relacionamento sejam compreendidas e realizadas de forma ética, inclusiva e alinhada aos valores institucionais;

Compromissos de gestão de MSF-Brasil

  • Atuar de forma alinhada aos valores e princípios da organização, promovendo uma gestão de pessoas ética, equitativa e inclusiva, que valorize a escuta ativa, fomente uma cultura de feedback contínuo e incentive o desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Aplicar e disseminar as diretrizes éticas de MSF-Brasil e os Compromissos Comportamentais da organização, assegurando um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso, transparente e coerente com os princípios da organização;
  • Favorecer a colaboração entre áreas e o trabalho transversal, desenvolvendo e aprimorando processos integrados com olhar estratégico;
  • Contribuir ativamente para o Planejamento Estratégico e Plano Anual, participando de monitoramentos periódicos, identificando riscos e ajustando prioridades com responsabilidade e visão sistêmica;
  • Garantir a implementação e promoção ativa de práticas de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI), valorizando diferentes perspectivas, combatendo qualquer forma de discriminação e promovendo um ambiente seguro para todas as pessoas;

Promoção de cultura ágil e contribuição para mudança

  • Adotar metodologias ágeis, incentivando ciclos curtos de entrega, aprendizado contínuo e adaptação às mudanças;
  • Estimular a criatividade e a experimentação, propondo soluções inovadoras e ousadas que ampliem a relevância e o engajamento de MSF-Brasil junto ao público brasileiro;
  • Basear e incentivar decisões em dados e evidências, fortalecendo a transparência, a eficiência e o foco em resultados;
    Atuar como agente de mudança no processo de transformação do Hub, contribuindo para a implementação de novas formas de trabalhar, incluindo cultura "data-driven" e metodologia ágil.

Requisitos:

4. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?

  • Formação relevante na área
  • Sólida experiência em liderança de crescimento e captação de recursos
  • Experiência com gestão de pessoas e canais diversos de marketing
  • Ter domínio do inglês (avançado)
  • Conhecimentos de estratégia de marketing e análise de resultados, propostas, tendências
  • Conhecimentos de metodologia ágil e gestão de projetos

title: Senior Coating Advisor
description:
Job Title: Senior Coating Advisor

Location: Applicants must reside in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Schedule: Remote
Department: Technical Services

Reports To: Area Manager Service Operations, Argentina & Brazil

Travel Requirement: Up to 80% travel, both domestic and international, with a valid US visa.

Important: Please submit CVs in English

Hempel, founded in Denmark in 1915, is a world-leading supplier of trusted coating solutions. Across the globe, our products protect and beautify buildings, infrastructure and other assets, and play an essential role in our customers' businesses. They help minimize maintenance costs, improve aesthetics, and increase energy efficiency. Through our brands Hempel, Neogard, Crown Paints, Wattyl and Farrow & Ball, we provide solutions for the Marine, Energy, Infrastructure and Decorative industries.

Job Summary: Hempel is seeking an experienced and technically skilled Senior Coating Advisor to join our Technical Services team in Brazil, within the marine segment. This role is responsible for providing technical advice and support to sales teams, as well as conducting technical analyses of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. Key responsibilities include preparing and conducting technical sales briefings for customers and company representatives, researching customer technical specifications, estimating the costs, resources, time, and technical requirements for modifying, configuring, and installing products or solutions, and evaluating sales proposals to ensure they are technically accurate and aligned with the organization's quality standards.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Fulfill assigned projects in accordance with the requirements of the Work Orders.
  • Advise customers on the correct use of Hempel products and paint systems by following instructions provided in current technical documentation (Product Data Sheets, application instructions, or other relevant technical materials).
  • Ensure compliance with agreed painting specifications, including technical standards, work procedures, and best painting practices.
  • Keep all parties informed of work progress through Progress Reports. In case of deviations or non-conformities, notify the customer in writing, provide recommendations for preventive/corrective actions, and follow up on their implementation.
  • Monitor and control paint inventory for the project, provide timely updates to front/back office sales, and ensure proper implementation of paint consumption planning and procedures.
  • Conduct coating condition surveys onshore and offshore as required.
  • Actively participate in claim handling procedures and assist in their resolution.
  • Provide pre-sales and/or post-sales technical support to customers, including testing and maintaining products, equipment, and services; evaluate and recommend new products or equipment upgrades as needed to meet customer requirements.
  • Monitor and resolve recurring issues to ensure ongoing customer satisfaction.
  • Manage complex and large-scale projects effectively.
  • Train customers on the features and application of purchased products when needed.
  • Ensure quality and timely reporting of all work activities.
  • Support the sales force regarding technical aspects of the company's products and services.
  • Complete all required reports with high quality and on time.
  • Utilize information tools efficiently in accordance with Hempel's procedures.
  • Ensure all Technical Services staff equipment is used according to project procedures and specifications, and that all equipment is calibrated and in good working condition.
  • Comply with training programs to acquire the necessary skills, knowledge, and behaviors.
  • Travel to project sites and prepare/distribute technical reports; travel accounts for approximately 80% of working time, both domestically and internationally.
  • Conduct work safely and responsibly, following Hempel's HSE guidelines and the HSE procedures of each worksite.
  • Use all required personal protective equipment (PPE) and ensure it is always in good condition for the job.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English is required; Spanish is a plus.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a Coating Advisor in a technical service role, preferably within the marine segment.
  • Relevant certifications such as NACE, FROSIO, ABRACO, or IARCOR.
  • Strong knowledge of the paint and coatings industry.
  • Technologically proficient and comfortable using digital reporting tools.
  • University degree in Chemistry or a related field is a plus.
  • Completion of required internal training as outlined in Hempel's Group Training Policy.

What's in it for you?

100% employer-paid medical coverage for you and your immediate family (spouse and children)

Standard CLT contract benefits, including:

  • Paid vacations
  • 13th salary
  • Severance fund (FGTS)
  • Social security
  • Paid sick leave

We're on a mission to double our impact. To succeed, we need bright minds and team players. Which is why, from day one, your input, ideas and initiative are not only welcomed, but expected. In return, you will enjoy great opportunities for development in a growing global company – and be part of the solution by contributing to our global impact.

At Hempel, we are committed to everyone feeling safe, valued and treated equally, in an environment where each employee can bring their authentic selves to work. We believe that inclusion is key to innovation and by bringing together the most diverse perspectives and talents, we can achieve great things, together.
